name: RBF Particle Volume Path Tracing
definition: A method for path tracing particle volumes by modeling the volume as a scalar field composed of additive weighted radial basis functions (RBFs), specifically Gaussians, allowing for full control over volume reconstruction filters without simplification or proxy geometry.
summary: RBF Particle Volume Path Tracing renders particle data as a continuous scalar field using radial basis functions and delta tracking, avoiding the visual clutter and performance issues of splatting methods.
